layouts.name: Moscow Raceway
layouts.description: Combined mapped configurations: Moscow Raceway Grand Prix 2, Moscow Raceway Grand Prix 1, Moscow Raceway FIM, Moscow Raceway Sprint 1, Moscow Raceway Grand Prix 5, Moscow Raceway Supersprint. Shared sections count once in the mapped branch length. Branch identity and historical alignment still need review.

layouts.name: Moscow Raceway Grand Prix 2
layouts.description: The operator Grand Prix 2 highlighted configuration identifies the full western course and Mercedes Arena with both back-straight chicanes. The pinned independent source route measures 4099.2 m; the operator states 4070 m. Parallel pit and service routes are excluded.

layouts.description: The operator Grand Prix 1 highlighted configuration identifies the full western course and Mercedes Arena with the plain back straight. The pinned independent source route measures 3984 m; the operator states 3955 m. Parallel pit and service routes are excluded.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The general venue entry displays a network of six independently identified operator configurations: Grand Prix 1, Grand Prix 2, Grand Prix 5, FIM, Sprint 1 and Supersprint. Published highlighted plans identify each component; these include the full and bypassed Mercedes Arena, western bend bypass, back-straight chicanes, Sprint connector and Supersprint closure. Each component is separately selectable. The network is a set of configurations, not a single timed lap. Parallel pit routes and unverified later fork additions are excluded. The independent unique branch distance is 4853.8 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
